social_media.headline: Extreme Geomagnetic Conditions Reached
social_media.summary: Geomagnetic activity has reached the G5 (Extreme) level. Additional periods of severe to extreme storming remain possible while CME-driven conditions persist.
what_we_know: The active Warning remains in effect through 0600 UTC Mon May 13 2024.
Power, HF radio, GNSS, satellite, and aurora effects are possible.
This is the only G5 Observed Alert for this event.

footer.left: Follow sector-specific procedures for extreme geomagnetic activity.

visual.alt_text: Operational visualization of observed G5 extreme geomagnetic storm conditions.
